description: Catalog L-03 (Ranking noisy estimates): the simulated league (SR-06) by size group, the frozen first draw (data/precomputed/league-30.json, seed 20261030) and the twenty seeded replays (seed 20261030 + r) with their exact means.

l03.truth.ext.note: groups among the true top 5 and bottom 5

l03.truerank.note: true rank of each unit (1 = largest true value)

l03.first.ext.note: the frozen first draw (seed 20261030): groups among the top 5 and bottom 5 by estimate

l03.first.rank.note: position of each unit by estimate in the frozen first draw

l03.replays.note: replays r = 1..20 of the frozen draw's seed (seed 20261030 + r): per replay the units of each size among the 10 extreme positions by estimate, the top-10 overlap with the true top 10 and the pairs ordered against the true order, and their means over the 20 replays

league.se.small.note: SE of a small unit's estimate

league.se.medium.note: SE of a medium unit's estimate

league.se.large.note: SE of a large unit's estimate

league.default.top10overlap.note: units of the top 10 by estimate in the true top 10, frozen first draw

league.default.U10.estpos.note: U10: position by estimate in the frozen first draw

league.default.U18.estpos.note: U18: position by estimate in the frozen first draw

league.default.U19.estpos.note: U19: position by estimate in the frozen first draw

league.replay20.avg.ext10small.note: mean of 20 integer counts, so two decimals are exact

league.replay20.avg.ext10medium.note: mean of 20 integer counts, so two decimals are exact

league.replay20.avg.ext10large.note: mean of 20 integer counts, so two decimals are exact

league.replay20.avg.top10overlap.note: mean of 20 integer counts, so two decimals are exact

league.replay20.avg.misordered.note: mean of 20 integer counts, so two decimals are exact

league.replay.r01.ext10small.note: replay 1: small units among the 10 extreme positions by estimate

league.replay.r01.ext10medium.note: replay 1: medium units among the 10 extreme positions by estimate

league.replay.r01.ext10large.note: replay 1: large units among the 10 extreme positions by estimate

league.replay.r01.top10overlap.note: replay 1: units in both the top 10 by estimate and the true top 10

league.replay.r01.misordered.note: replay 1: pairs the estimates order against the true order
